note: The Motion Studio service catalog. A client (or Talha) names a CODE; tools/studio/new-piece.mjs takes its defaults from here; the portfolio page and the Bengali guide (docs/business/CATALOG.md) are made from this file. Prices: USD for international clients, BDT for local ones — research basis in docs/business/research/R1-market-pricing.md and R2-clients-payments-bd.md (2026-11-07). Every sample is CONCEPT work for a fictional brand and must be labelled so.

services.name: Product Launch Film
services.what: The hero video for a launch day: a big kinetic-type promise, the product UI floating in 3D space with a slow camera, three benefit beats, a light sweep and a logo lockup. Keynote-style.
services.bestFor: Funded SaaS / AI startups launching or relaunching; Product Hunt and X launch posts; the landing-page hero.

services.name: Feature Drop
services.what: One new feature in 15 seconds: a hook line, the cursor walks to the feature, a smooth punch-in on the UI moment, the result, a CTA.
services.bestFor: SaaS teams that ship every week and post updates on X / LinkedIn; changelog emails.

services.name: 3D UI Tour
services.what: The app's screens as glass-edged panels in 3D space; the camera dollies from panel to panel (dashboard → pipeline → report) with parallax and depth of field.
services.bestFor: Product pages, sales decks, investor demos — when the product has 3–5 key screens.

services.name: App Store Preview
services.what: A vertical phone-first preview: taps, swipes and screen changes inside a phone, short benefit captions, made to the App Store / Play Store preview limits (15–30 s).
services.bestFor: Mobile app makers — App Store and Google Play listings, Reels and TikTok ads.
references: Apple App Store featured app previews

services.name: Changelog / Release Reel
services.what: "What's new in v3.0" — 4–6 updates in quick cuts: version stamp, icon + one line + a tiny UI snippet per update, a closing lockup.
services.bestFor: Dev tools and SaaS with monthly releases; community and newsletter posts.
includes: a reusable template for next releases

services.name: Integrations Hub
services.what: The product as a glowing hub; app icons orbit in, beams connect them, data packets travel, a count of integrations lands.
services.bestFor: Automation, API and platform companies announcing integrations or a marketplace.

services.name: AI Agent Demo
services.what: An AI agent at work: a prompt is typed, a labelled agent cursor clicks through a clean UI, status chips tick from 'working' to 'done', the result lands. The 2026 launch format for AI products.
services.bestFor: AI startups showing an agent or copilot doing a real task; launch posts on X.
references: Cursor and Devin style agent clips

services.name: How-It-Works Explainer
services.what: A voiced 45–90 s explainer: the problem, the turn, three simple steps with friendly flat illustration and icons, proof, CTA. Script, voice-over and music included.
services.bestFor: Landing pages, onboarding, sales calls — health, fintech, B2B services that need clarity.
services.voice: English AI voice (Gemini) or client's own

services.name: Workflow Diagram in Motion
services.what: A process as a living diagram: nodes draw in, packets travel the paths, a branch splits on a condition, failures retry, success lights up the end.
services.bestFor: Automation, fintech ops, logistics and B2B tools whose value is the workflow.

services.name: 3D Architecture Stack
services.what: Real 3D: the system's layers (edge, API, compute, data, encryption) float apart in an isometric stack with labels, data runs through them, they lock back together.
services.bestFor: Infrastructure, security and developer platforms explaining 'how it is built'.

services.name: Data Story
services.what: Bloomberg / FT-style: a line chart draws itself, the key point is annotated, numbers count up, a comparison resolves — calm editorial type, one accent colour.
services.bestFor: Research firms, fintech, reports, investor letters, LinkedIn thought leadership.
includes: data checked against the client's source

services.name: Investor Metrics Reel
services.what: A funding or milestone announcement: big KPI count-ups (ARR, growth, customers, countries), a growth curve, a donut, a lockup — confident and exact.
services.bestFor: Startups announcing a round or a milestone; annual reviews; investor updates.

services.name: Map Story
services.what: A world map: hubs light up, routes draw as arcs, a counter runs, the camera pushes into a region — for reach, logistics and expansion stories.
services.bestFor: Logistics, travel, global SaaS expansion, NGOs showing reach.

services.name: Editorial Explainer
services.what: Vox-style: paper textures, headline cards, highlighter strokes over key lines, a document zoom, a hand-drawn arrow, a voiced narration on a real topic.
services.bestFor: Media brands, newsletters, YouTube explainer channels, think tanks.

services.name: 3D Logo Sting
services.what: A 5–7 s logo reveal in real 3D: beveled letters flip up, light runs across the bevels, one sub-bass hit and a sparkle on the lock.
services.bestFor: Every brand: video intros/outros, YouTube channels, event openers, ads.

services.name: Kinetic Type Manifesto
services.what: A brand belief told in big moving type cut to the beat: words slam, split, swap and morph; colour blocks wipe; it ends on the brand line.
services.bestFor: Brand campaigns, hiring videos, event openers, social posts with no footage.

services.name: Brand System in Motion
services.what: The identity animated: logo construction, palette swatches, type specimen, pattern and real applications (cards, app icon, signage) — a living brand book.
services.bestFor: Branding agencies presenting work; companies launching a rebrand.
includes: motion tokens file (eases, durations) for the brand

services.name: Vertical Social Ad
services.what: A 15 s vertical ad built for the feed: the hook in the first second, three benefit beats, a big CTA, voice-over and captions inside the platform safe zones.
services.bestFor: Performance marketers and DTC / app brands running Meta, TikTok and YouTube Shorts ads.

services.name: Event / Webinar Promo
services.what: Date, venue or link, speakers as clean monogram cards (no faces needed), the agenda in three beats, a countdown and a register button.
services.bestFor: Conferences, webinars, launches, community meetups, workshops.

services.name: 3D Glass Hero Title
services.what: Real 3D glass: a refracting glass form turns in front of a giant headline so the type bends through it, then the tagline lands — the most premium 8–10 seconds a brand can open with.
services.bestFor: Landing-page heroes, keynote openers, premium product teasers.

services.name: Dev-Tool Launch (3D code)
services.what: Syntax-highlighted code on a lit 3D slab rotating into a readable rest, a terminal run, the result — for developer products.
services.bestFor: Dev tools, APIs, SDKs, open-source launches.

services.name: Lower-Thirds & Titles Pack
services.what: A matched set of name bars, section titles, callouts and end cards on a transparent background, in the client's brand, ready to drop on any edit.
services.bestFor: YouTubers, podcasts, corporate video teams, event streams.

services.name: Talking Head + B-roll (5 styles)
services.what: Your talking-head recording edited in one of five named styles: Glass Split, Bubble Cut, Punch Type, Card Fan, Data Stage.
services.bestFor: Creators, coaches, founders on camera.

services.name: Long Episode + Reels
services.what: A long talking-head episode with motion-graphics cards and word-by-word captions, plus vertical Reels cut from it.
services.bestFor: YouTube channels, podcasts, courses.

services.name: Screen Tutorial
services.what: A long screen recording + voice turned into a clean 16:9 tutorial with zooms, cursor glow, chapter cards and captions.
services.bestFor: SaaS onboarding, course creators, software trainers.

services.name: Screen-Recording Commercial
services.what: A screen recording of an app turned into a commercial: zooms onto UI moments, cursor glow, 3D tilt, click boom, end card.
services.bestFor: SaaS and app makers who already have the product running.

services.name: AI-Clip Client Promo
services.what: A client's AI-generated clips + voice + music cut into a production-ready promo, 16:9 and a designed 9:16.
services.bestFor: Local businesses with AI clips — food, retail, real estate.

services.name: Universal Reels Cut-downs
services.what: Vertical Reels cut from a finished video that upload unchanged to Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube Shorts.
services.bestFor: Anyone with a long video who needs short-form reach.

services.name: Bengali Explainer Board
services.what: A voiced Bengali tutorial with no footage: drawn app windows, chats, folders, code, diagrams; captions with the spoken word in gold.
services.bestFor: Bangladeshi edtech, NGOs, local SaaS, course creators.

services.name: Launch Kit
services.what: PL1 launch film + FD1 feature drops ×2 + KP1 metrics + 9:16 / 1:1 cut-downs + LG1 sting — everything for one launch week.
services.bestFor: Startups with a launch date.

services.name: Ad Pack ×10
services.what: Ten vertical SA1 ads from one brief: 3 hooks × 3 angles + 1 offer, all aspect ratios, captions — built to A/B test.
services.bestFor: DTC and app brands spending on Meta / TikTok ads.

services.name: Monthly Motion Retainer
services.what: A set number of pieces every month (e.g. 4 feature drops + 8 social ads + 1 data story), one request queue, 48-hour turnaround on small pieces.
services.bestFor: SaaS marketing teams and agencies that ship constantly.
